questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

**Man : Mammal :: Butterfly : .......**
questions.solution:
Here the logic is:

Man : Mammal → Humans are classified as mammals.

Mammal → Mammal, (class Mammalia), any member of the group of vertebrate animals in which the young are nourished with milk from special mammary glands of the mother.

Similarly,

Butterfly : ? → Butterflies are classified as insects.

Insects → Insects have segmented bodies, jointed legs, and external skeletons (exoskeletons).

Hence, ‘Butterfly : Insect’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusion carefully and decide which of the following options is true with respect to the given conclusion.

**Statements:**

Men who are handsome are generally of the intellectual type.

Vikram is handsome.

**Conclusion:**

questions.solution:
Statement ⟶ Men who are handsome are generally or most of them are the intellectual type.

Conclusion ⟶ In the statement, the intellectual word is used for handsome men but clearly stated that most of them are intellectual types not talking about all men. So Vikram is an intellectual or not, we can not confirm it from the above statement.

Hence, **‘Probably true’** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven students are standing in a row. B is standing to the left of C and to the right of A. D is standing to the right of E and to the left of A. F is standing to the right of C and to the left of G. Who is standing in the middle?
questions.solution:
Let us consider all of them are facing the north.

1) B is standing to the left of C and to the right of A.

2) F is standing to the right of C and to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe296d16fed5b69b94fcaa2e31ee16beb54434313696956428f50497351bf70.png] 

3) D is standing to the right of E and to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a539e9a9859990c1cd1071f9a0891b14ef71dfc3420f0788ccdf19d59881a67.png] 

Hence,** ‘B’ **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e549cb45ac78aca065082aa5a940b1d6506603cfff2fd1300a22049ad93dc6.png] 

**"And"** is used for the** first person** in a sentence.

For example,

1) ***B*** is standing to the left of C ***and ***to the right of A → It means B is standing to the left of C and ***B is standing to the right of A.***

2) ***F*** is standing to the right of C ***and*** to the left of G → It means F is standing to the right of C and ***F is standing to the left of G.***

questions.question: If SCIENCE is coded as 14 and MATHS is coded as 10, then what will be the code for EXAMINATION?
questions.solution:
Here the logic is:

Total numbers of alphabets in word ⨯ 2

SCIENCE = 7 (Total numbers of alphabets) ⨯ 2 = 14

MATHS = 5 (Total numbers of alphabets) ⨯ 2 = 10

Similarly,

EXAMINATION = 11 (Total numbers of alphabets) ⨯ 2 = 22

Hence, ‘22’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs/numbers need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10
questions.solution:
1) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number ÷ and +, 8 and 4 -

LHS = 4 + 2 ÷ 8

= 4 + 1 ÷ 4

= 17/4 ≠ R.H.S

2) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign ÷ and +

LHS = 8 + 2 ÷ 4

= 8 + 1 ÷ 2

= 17/2 ≠ R.H.S

3) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number + and ÷, 8 and 2

LHS = 2 + 8 ÷ 4

= 2 + 2

= 4 ≠ R.H.S

4) Given expression : 8 ÷ 2 + 4 = 10

Interchanged the sign and number + and ÷, 2 and 4

LHS = 8 + 4 ÷ 2

= 8 + 2

= 10 = RHS

Hence, ‘ + and ÷, 2 and 4’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

Some girls are women.

No woman is brown.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some girls are not brown.

II. Some women are girls.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• Meaning of** "Some A are B"** in Syllogism - there is *at least one point in A which is in B*.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - *each point of A is in B*.
 
• This explains why "some" can be considered as a subset of "all".
 
• Therefore, *if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" is always true.*

***The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows -***__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f63e5ab1df497bafc6311d8460f7ecfa9c2f8a9b3f88aadeb175faf87f28e2f0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some girls are not brown → **True** (It is definitely true because some girls are woman and no woman is brown since which part of girls that is women can never be brown, hence true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb78aa9e0d48b31c6acb140e13bc7e08013c6ada7df030edbf13695573778af5.png] 

II. Some women are girls →** True **(It is definitely true because some girls are woman so some women are girls)

Hence, **Both conclusions I and II follow.**

questions.question:
Seven friends — Ajith, Bala, Hari, David, Raja, Sekar, and Guna — are sitting around a circular table. David is not the neighbor of Hari and Raja. Ajith is the neighbor of Bala and Hari. Guna, who is second to the left of David, is the neighbor of Sekar and Raja.

What is the position of Hari?

options.text: To the immediate left of Ajith
To the immediate right of Raja
Third to the left of Sekar
Second to the left of Bala

questions.solution:
Let us consider all of them facing inside.

1) Guna, who is second to the left of David, is the neighbour of Sekar and Raja.

2) David is not the neighbour of Hari and Raja. (So raja is immediate left of Guna)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/740073c2401408f5cab315f024c5331c2576c7d53591f7ed329b93e384104d31.png] 

3) Ajith is the neighbour of Bala and Hari. (So, Hari is immediate right of Ajith)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1d06b3ddde97d3cba66dcd2cf4b70632ab6cc5e86b257cd1ff65d327b0ce0fa.png] 

Hence, ‘Third to the left of Sekar’ is the correct answer.
